evals.prompt: Deliver this completed feature as a PR. The repository may have its own base-branch rules; inspect them, run the right checks, and do not merge.
evals.expected_output: Inspects repository state and workflow, preserves unrelated changes, validates the full change, opens a correctly targeted PR only with authorization, and does not merge.

evals.prompt: Prepare a release from the changes on the current branch. Do not assume a develop branch or publish anything without asking.
evals.expected_output: Inspects release documentation and version impact, uses SemVer guidance, avoids assuming branch model, and pauses before unauthorized tags/publication.
